data.headline: HDFC Bank reports strong Q4 results, net profit up 18%
data.content: HDFC Bank Ltd reported a net profit of Rs 17,616 crore for the quarter ended March 2026, up 18% year-on-year.

data.headline: HDFC Bank announces Rs 5 dividend for FY26
data.content: The board of HDFC Bank Ltd has recommended a dividend of Rs 5 per equity share for FY2025-26.

data.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.25%
data.content: The Reserve Bank of India maintained the benchmark repo rate at 6.25% in its latest monetary policy meeting.
